title: perityle quinqueflora
intro: Perityle quinqueflora, commonly known as Mexican chalk plant or five-flowered perityle, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents present in Perityle quinqueflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contributing to its medicinal properties.
